complexity_growth_guard: Exact construction depth and at least one declared interior-complexity diagnostic must strictly increase so stabilization is not caused by frozen generation.
persistence_rule: The stabilized signature must persist for all depths in the declared W=4 window under identical frozen Test/TestPack versions.
stabilization_definition: Four consecutive completed post-calibration development depths with byte-identical normalized full Test-Pack/scanner signatures after the last qualifying structural-shock family.
